metadata.source: local OHLCV replay of deployed screen templates
caveats: Evidence label: exploratory_h09_not_evidence. Exploratory only: H-09 never enters the forward scorecard, the D-75 pass bar, the kill rule, /expectancy or any v0.2 verdict.

TradingView's screener cannot be rewound. Ranking, confluence, catalysts, earnings/liquidity checks, portfolio caps and the live entry-zone branch selection are not replayed; only gate step 5 is applied.
Both arms share the signal stream, the entry zone, the stop and the D-73 fills. They differ only in target selection, the gate floor and the exit.
The signal stream is the D-71 engine's one-position-at-a-time entry list; it is not the live signal rate.
Structural levels are OHLCV-only (no TradingView resistance), so the target population differs from live.
The stop is 2xATR from the signal close, not from the fill (a disclosed deviation from D-71's fill-based stop).
The v0.1 arm is a reconstruction of live v0.1 rules on replay geometry, not the live v0.1 journal. It reproduces the 5c midpoint-vs-entry-low quirk and infer_exit's T2-before-T1 ordering on purpose.
Family names come from the live display name (G11). Screens whose display name does not normalize to a family run as 'unknown'; the stem-based sensitivity is secondary.
Trades still open at the data edge close at the last close ('eod'); they are excluded from the primary aggregate unless the 36-day horizon is covered.
Universe is today's S&P 500 snapshot (survivorship bias); one window and several cuts mean any positive result is a hypothesis, not evidence.
